        I have been using the Lava Agni 4 for some time now, and I am really satisfied with its performance. The phone feels premium because of its metal body and solid build quality. The display is bright and smooth, making it great for watching videos and browsing.

        The Dimensity 8350 processor handles multitasking and gaming very well. Apps open quickly, and there is no major lag. With 8GB RAM and 256GB storage, there is more than enough space for daily use.

        The camera performs well in good lighting and takes clear, detailed photos. Battery life is also reliable and easily lasts a full day with normal usage. Fast charging is an added advantage.

        Overall, this phone offers great value for money with strong performance, good design, and smooth software. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a powerful and stylish smartphone in this price range.

      • Atharva Pawar
        4 out of 5 stars
        Good but not best
        Reviewed in India on 15 May 2026
        Colour: LUNAR MISTSize: 8GB + 256GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Bought this phone a month ago, upgraded from Poco M2 Pro. Thought let's give a chance to an Indian Brand.

        Battery - Barely gets through the day. You need to plug in at night if your usage is high. Lava should upgrade the battery. Cheaper phones are getting 6000 Mah Battery. Charging is fast, gets 20 to 90 in about 30 mins

        Display - Display is good and smooth but sometimes it stutters for a minute or so (stutters means does not work at 120 hz) and then becomes normal, I guess that's a bug which can be fixed by software update.

        UI - Clean UI no ads but feels a bit outdated.

        Performance - Phone is smooth and fast no lag till date. Daily tasks seem fast.

        Sound - Stereo Speaker but it lacks clarity and loudness.

        Camera - Rear Camera is average, Front is bad. The front camera is 50 MP but even a 12 MP camera can take better photos than this.

        Build - Metal frame with glass back is good and sturdy so no problems with that.

        5 out of 5 stars
        Absolutely amazing and refreshing device for the enthusiasts who are a bit conscious financially.
        Reviewed in India on 25 December 2025
        Colour: LUNAR MISTSize: 8GB + 256GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Absolutely amazing phone sure no phone is best in everything and this is no exception, so let me divide my review in three parts:

        Light zone: Build quality of this phone is second to only the titanium builds (which have their own problems).

        Speakers: They are very loud and clear with clear bass.

        Performance: One of the best tuned dimensity 8350 powered device, maybe linked to the non-restrictive nature of lava's rom in this regard.

        Display: Absolutely phenomenal, plenty bright and colorful, performs great in low light too, may have a bit more sharpening but until one is being too frequent with other high end phones, no one will be able to notice the same.

        Grey area: Sensors: everything one can imagine except nfc (which until you are actually using tap to pay is vestigial at best anyway)

        Software: Since softwares are subjective, you will only like it if you are quite minimal about it or want no restrictions in foreground performance (background is again subjective since ram management ain't the best in this) or are an absolute fanatic of having android stay out of your way as well as hogging the least of your resources down, well this bloatware free software is the best Android there is.

        Usb port: 3.2 gen 1 is an absolute beast, rivalled no short but by flagships only, but you need supporting hardware or it won't seem that good, a usb 3 enable cable can unlock a lot more for you though some part of it is linked with the upcoming android 16 update. There aren't any bugs that I could find in this and I have been an beta tester for many phones, be assured this is the most stable phone software that there is period.

        Camera: Again subjective I feel that this is where the minimalism of lava on android actually backfired a little, these sensors need some algorithm to take out everything that there is but unfortunately that's the price one has to pay to get unrestricted experience of their device, that being said it's far very far from being a bad camera, it's actually very very good for the price, and while the other things rival the top of the line models this rivals it's actual counterpart the midrangers of any brand very well (the only one who has really got an edge is the Motorola edge series only pun intended).

        Black zone: Battery: if you are coming from a newish samsung then you are great, it will feel better than any samsung phone currently out in the market, but in raw durability it is 1-2 hour behind the Chinese (although the compromise with them is huge, don't just go for aesthetics of the phone or software, there are a lot of bugs in them).

        All in all, buy this phone if you want an actually good all rounder and not just a price filler of the bigger brands.

      • Diptendu Sil
        4 out of 5 stars
        A decent budget phone with some compromises
        Reviewed in India on 22 December 2025
        Colour: PHANTOM BLACKSize: 8GB + 256GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        This is a budget phone, so I look at it like a budget phone.

        Pro:

        Looks: For the price, the phone looks pretty good and feels well built.

        Software: I like the clean near-stock and almost bloat-free software.

        Display: Amoled display with decent quality and colors for the price and the 120hz feels smooth.

        Sound: Having stereo speakers is definitely useful, considering a lot of budget phones skip that.

        Performance: I didn't experience any lags in day to day performance, considering this phone uses a good CPU. I don't game on mobile, so can't comment on the gaming performance.

        Cons:

        Software: Software updates feel slow. Still no android 16 (or no news of it), but then I don't expect much from a budget phone. While I daily drive pixel 10 pro, but even brands like Nothing already pushed android 16 on their midrange and budget phones. I wish Lava at least publishes an official timeline for the software updates to set proper expectations.

        Features: It is missing some features which I can find on similar priced phones, for some, the phone has its own implementation which doesn't behave that well. Example, circle to search isn't officially available so Lava included their own version of this feature (basically taking a freeform screenshot and searching on google lens). My main complaint is that activation of that by holding on the navigation line doesn't work that easily and reliably.

        Hardware:

        The haptic feedback is absolutely horrible. It feels like a cheap vibration motor from a lower budget phone. I have also used Nothing 3a which is just a very little bit more expensive but the haptic feedback on that phones feels miles ahead. Official websites use the word "flagship" to describe the vibration engine/motor which is a blatant lie.

        Camera: They pretty much ripped off Google pixel camera's icon for the camera icon. Which the camera software is decent, the animation for switching between main and ultrawide camera is horrible and outdated.

        Battery life: While on paper the battery capacity is good and it charges pretty fast, the battery life leaves more to be desired.

        Overall I recommend this phone at this price but this is a budget phone and it makes some compromises.

        I give it 3.5 / 5

      About this Item

      • Blazing Performance — Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8350 (4 nm) octa-core chipset clocked at 3.35 GHz, the Agni 4 delivers over 1.4 million on AnTuTu v10 for lightning-fast multitasking and gaming.

      • Premium Metal Frame Design — Crafted in aluminium-alloy frame with Gorilla Glass protection, and IP64 splash/dust resistance making Agni 4 sturdy but sleek.

A premium aluminium frame, IP64 rating, Vayu AI features, and a customizable Action Button complete the experience.
